usage: The verb 炒 (caau2) means to stir-fry in cooking.
炒 is used to describe a cooking method where food is quickly cooked over high heat with oil.
It is often followed by the food ingredient, e.g., 炒飯 (caau2 faan6) means stir-fried rice.
炒 can be used in imperative sentences to ask someone to stir-fry something.
炒 can also imply a fast, tossing motion in the cooking process.
